ns2:section.sectionText: A prerequisite of BADM 350 will be enforced. This course will open to all students in the College of Business on Monday, November 13, 2017 and to ISE students and Informatics Minors on Monday, November 27, 2017 at approximately 10:00 a.m. There are currently 5 reserved seats for College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, January 19, 2018 at approximately 10:00 a.m.
